headline: Madras HC quashes ITC reversal orders where GSTR-3B filed by 30.11.2021 under Section 16(5)
reference: S.H. Mubin v. Deputy State Tax Officer - I, Madras High Court, WP No. 46329 of 2026, decided 19-11-2026 (Krishnan Ramasamy J.)
summary_points: Issue: Order dated 26.10.2023 reversed ITC for FY 2017-18 as time-barred under Section 16(4) of the CGST Act, 2017.
Held: Following its order of 17.10.2024, the Court held ITC claimed in returns filed by 30.11.2021 is protected under Section 16(5), and quashed the order to that extent.
The Department is restrained from proceedings on limitation, must de-freeze bank accounts and refund or allow adjustment of amounts collected.
Liberty is left to the Department to act in accordance with law on other ITC issues such as wrong, excess or fake ITC claims.
who_is_affected: Registered persons whose ITC for FY 2017-18 to 2020-21 was denied as time-barred under Section 16(4) despite returns filed on or before 30.11.2021.
action_required: Affected taxpayers should review pending or adjudicated demands based only on limitation and consider relying on this ruling and Section 16(5) in writ or appeal proceedings.

Madras High Court on ITC time-limit: Section 16(5) protects claims made by 30.11.2021

In S.H. Mubin v. Deputy State Tax Officer - I (WP No. 46329 of 2026, decided 19 November 2026), the Madras High Court quashed an order reversing ITC for FY 2017-18 on the ground of limitation under Section 16(4) of the CGST Act.

Following its earlier common order of 17.10.2024, the Court held that ITC claimed in returns filed up to 30.11.2021 is saved by Section 16(5), for FY 2017-18 to 2020-21.

Key directions:
- Department restrained from proceeding on the limitation issue
- Bank accounts to be de-freezed
- Amounts collected to be refunded, or adjusted against future tax

The Department retains liberty to proceed on other grounds such as wrong, excess or fake ITC claims.

Takeaway: if your ITC was denied purely as time-barred, but your return was filed by 30.11.2021, you have a strong ground to challenge the demand.

Please verify with the official source and the full judgment before acting.
